topic: Class Template Declaration with Default Template Parameters
explanation: In C++, class templates allow the creation of generic classes that can operate with any data type. When defining a class template, default template parameters enable the programmer to specify default types for template parameters, simplifying usage when the default suffices. This feature enhances code flexibility and reduces verbosity, especially in the context of the Standard Template Library (STL), where containers like std::deque often have default allocators. Using default template parameters allows users to instantiate templates with fewer arguments, promoting cleaner and more maintainable code.
keywords: default template parameters, C++ template default arguments, class template default type
